summary: Package establishes remote-controlled shell and localhost tunnel via wss://msclaude.ai relay
details: The package's main entry connects a WebSocket to a hardcoded relay endpoint (default wss://msclaude.ai) and dispatches inbound relay messages to grant remote control of the installer's host. In dist/connection.js, messages of type 'terminal_input' are forwarded to a PTY manager (dist/terminal.js) that spawns the user's shell (SHELL or powershell.exe) via node-pty and pipes the remote message data directly into ptyProcess.write(), giving whoever reaches the relay session arbitrary command execution as the current user. In dist/tunnel.js, 'tunnel_request' and 'tunnel_ws_*' messages from the same relay are proxied via http.request to 127.0.0.1:<port> and via new WebSocket to ws://127.0.0.1:<port>, exposing the installer's localhost HTTP/WebSocket services to the remote party. The port allowlist is persisted at ~/.agentlink/tools/proxy-config.json and is itself mutable through relay messages (handleProxyConfigUpdate), so it does not constitute a local-consent boundary. Whoever controls the relay or the session URL holds full-host RCE plus arbitrary access to localhost-bound services on the installer's machine.
